summary: cisco.ucs will be removed from Ansible 16 since development moved to cisco.intersight, but it can still be installed with ansible-galaxy.
questions: Is cisco.ucs being removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: cisco.ucs removal from Ansible 16
answer_card.answer_md: `cisco.ucs` will be **removed from Ansible 16**. It has no active development; work moved to **cisco.intersight**. After removal you can still run `ansible-galaxy collection install cisco.ucs`.
